pylons_en: 1 arch pylon leaning back toward Thủ Thiêm, rounded crown, 113 m

model3d.notes: Asymmetric: 200 m main span (steel–concrete composite) + 115 m concrete back span; deck 27–28 m; pylon 110 m (WSP) / 113 m (Freyssinet, press). WSP calls it a 'backward sloping and curved pylon'. Pylon form, lean and stay layout measured off Commons photos; see pylon_custom.

pylon_custom.description: Single white arch pylon with a ROUNDED crown: two legs straddle the deck and curve together at the top; the whole arch curves in elevation and leans back away from the 200 m main span. Main-span stays fan from both legs to both deck edges; a second fan of back-stays runs to the 115 m back span. Below the deck the legs continue to a single pier block.

notes: Re-checked on 5 photos: crown is rounded (a smooth arch, not a pointed apex), back-stays fan into the back span. Engineer: smooth the apex.
review: Rounded crown noted; back-stay fan confirmed; geometry otherwise unchanged
